description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Quartz Eye Mode II (Fire, Ice, Lightning)], [Witch Resonance +5% Boost], [Dual Awoken Witch Mode I (Matoya)] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Witch Mode I (Matoya)
description.text: Witch abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Witch abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00 for Witch abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (8s)] to all allies, grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Witch Mode II (Matoya)] to the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Witch Mode II (Matoya)
description.text: Witch abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Witch abilities trigger 1 additional time, instant cast speed for Witch abilities, chases a Witch ability with Dual Potion Spell

description.name: Dual Potion Spell
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 10% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 10% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 10% (15s)] if 0-3 FF1 allies are alive, causes [Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)] if 4+ FF1 allies are alive

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 30% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 30% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 30% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 30% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 30% (15s)], [Imperil Water 30% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 30% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 30% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 30% (15s)]

description.name: Quartz Eye Mode II (Fire, Ice, Lightning)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking] after using a Fire/Ice/Lightning ability
